$Comment: Ice King mini-boss fight. Place it once with /encounter add AT_Ice_King_Encounter near the king. Waiting: the king is neutral; the first hit (health under 99%) starts the fight (hostile AT_Ice_King_Fight, boss bar, music, snow storm; they stay for every phase). Phase_1 ground (AT_Ice_King_Fight, CAE) -> 70% -> Phase_2 air (AT_Ice_King_Air, icebergs every 8 s) -> 45% -> Phase_3 Fridjitzu on the ground (AT_Ice_King_Fridjitzu, nunchucks) -> 20% -> Phase_4 enraged in the air (AT_Ice_King_Air_Enraged, icebergs every 5 s, lightning every 6-10 s). Built from vanilla Example_Boss and the Gobliterator encounter macros. 2026-10-21 reset fix: Player range 80, king Mob sensors 80, the 'king still alive' Target 120, Waiting resumes the phase that matches his health, Done goes back to Waiting with any living king. 2026-10-21: the cosmetic far lightning ('Thunder snow, far', a bolt 22-30 blocks from a player every 6-12 s) was removed (playtest: it looked like attacks fired away from him). The real lightning attack with its ground warning stays. 2026-10-21: every phase also answers the beacon AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain (ice rain: 10 shards around each player). 2026-10-22: the falling lightning, icebergs and ice rain drops are no longer spawned here: each block became a Beacon (AT_Ice_King_Drop_*) to the king, whose templates run the same block, so the king owns the damage ('killed by Ice King' instead of an unknown cause). Timers and conditions stay here.

Sensor.$Comment: 2026-10-21: 80 (was 40). Everything below only runs while a player is this close to the encounter marker, and players farther away lose the boss bar. 40 froze the phases when the fight drifted off (the ground roles leash at 80).

Instructions.$Comment: 2026-10-22 multiplayer (as vanilla Macro_Goblin_Gobliterator_Scale_Health): with 2+ players within 80 blocks and the king still untouched (health >= 99 %), +1000 max health (AT_Ice_King_Scale_Health_P2), refill to the new max (AT_Ice_King_Scale_TopUp) and 1.5 s of AT_Ice_King_Scaling, which the Waiting rules below skip so the dip in health share (3000/4000) can't start the fight or jump a phase. The Mob sensor comes first so the And forwards the king to the actions. P3 waits for the top-up of P2: the health >= 99 % filter blocks it while the share is down (a filter type may appear only once per list, so the Scaling marker is not checked here).

Go straight to the phase his health belongs to, lowest first: before this every reset put him back in the phase 1 role. Keep these numbers equal to the phase thresholds below (0.2 / 0.45 / 0.7).
